reasoning: This is a specialized UI toggle glyph for 'auto night mode off' (a crescent moon cut by a slash with an 'A' badge), where the slash cuts the crescent into fragmented shapes that are hard to parse at a glance. Because it represents a narrow device state/setting rather than a real-world task subject, it has almost no use in a general task manager.
